name: Magdall Waldrop
original_name: マグダル・ワールドロップ
source:
A Pucelle woman, more tiger than cat.
She started working at the opium den a month ago, it seems she really gave it her all at first, but, she gradually... Started acting strangely...
(edited from in-gme text)
